name: error-codes
description: Exercises 4 of the 5 stable error codes (protocol.md): sqlite_error (bad SQL), bad_request (wrong params shape), unsupported_op (unknown op), io_error (load from a nonexistent path). read_only is covered separately in read-only-mode.json since it requires the process to be started with --read-only. `exec` with a missing `sql` field is deliberately not exercised here -- it currently crashes the whole process instead of returning bad_request (see PLAN.md's known-issues note); the case format has no way to express an expected crash.
